XSS - JavaScript Context Escaping Bypass

XSS vulnerability in /search?q= parameter reflected in JavaScript context.
Application escapes HTML entities but fails to properly escape JavaScript context.

Vulnerable code in search.js line 78:
  <script>
    var searchQuery = "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_GET['q']); ?>";
    document.getElementById('results').textContent = searchQuery;
  </script>

Bypass payload: \"; alert('XSS'); //"
